protocol.name: reprise_tabs_v1
protocol.copyright: reprise private protocol: a program's windows as tabs of one caption.

interface.name: reprise_tabs_v1

description.summary: put a toplevel into another toplevel's caption tab group

interface.description: One global. A program that keeps its tabs as windows of their own asks for a new window to join the caption tab group of one it already shows, so the frame draws the tabs. Both toplevels must be the client's own.

request.name: join
request.description: When toplevel maps, it joins the tab group leader is in (or starts one with it) right after leader, and shows. Asked after toplevel mapped, it joins at once. Ignored when either toplevel belongs to another client, when they are the same, when leader is gone by then, or when the compositor keeps no tab groups. The user can pull the tab out again like any other.
